title: Armstrong's congestion and daily laxative
summary: Armstrong coughed constantly, slept in a fan's draft, and took Pluto Water then Swiss Kriss every night, per his doctor.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Didn't you say he also had something -- problem with coughing or congestion or --

His -- he had a bad congestion problem. He used to cough hard all the -- for years, years and years. He coughed hard all the time. But he used to do some of the damndest things. He'd eat a big meal over there in Italy, and he'd get on a great big fan and go get in a chair and lay back and go to sleep, and I used to look and wonder how he'd do things.
So his doctor traveled with him. Dr. Sheff told us,
don't try to emulate this guy, you know, because you'd die probably tomorrow, he said. He took a laxative every night for 40 years.

Every -- before Swiss Kriss he took Pluto Water, and it came in a bottle. It's strong stuff, you know. And then he got on his herbal Swiss Kriss. Later -- I think the reason Glaser helped switch him to that Swiss Kriss was it comes in little packages, and it's herbal and it's easy to carry. With that -- you know, traveling by plane all the time, carrying cases of that Pluto Water, I think Glaser was watching that bill go up --
-- on the plane rides. So he switched him over to that, yeah.
